findings.evidence: NEW round-3 finding (regression vs round-2 38/38). wave-B-api-order-results.json shows seq 30 with order_id:null + error:'placeKioskOrder failed at stage="quote" HTTP 429: {"message":"Trop de commandes. The retry path in postKioskOrderWithRetry (spec line 178-227) waited 13s and retried, but the retry ALSO failed because the rate-limit window had not fully cleared (5/min cap, retry_after backend says 60s). Final result: 37/38 = 97.4% success rate. Counter-evidence: wave-B-rate-limit-incidents.json claims `all_recovered: true` — that label is MISLEADING because it is computed as `incidents.every(i => i.retried)` (i.e. did we attempt a retry?), NOT as `incidents.every(i => i.recovered)` (did the retry succeed?). The label is a sidecar bug — api_results is ground truth. Severity = P2: (a) backend rate-limit IS working as designed (5 orders/min/branch is the production cap, 38 orders bursted in ~57s WILL exceed it); (b) the customer DOES get visible feedback — the global axios interceptor in resources/js/bootstrap.js:140 fires `error.rate_limited` toast with i18n string 'Trop de requêtes — patientez 30s avant de réessayer.' (resources/js/languages/fr.json:1013) on /frontend/order/quote 429; (c) NO data loss, NO silent failure. NOT P0 (no fiscal/data-integrity break, no silent error — toast + i18n string both present); NOT P1 (the user-facing message is real, not a generic crash). Improvements possible: kioskCart.quoteOrder action (resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js:601-634) does NOT have the same dedicated 429 handler that submitOrder does (line 715-733 with kiosk_rate_limited copy). The customer falls back to the generic interceptor toast, which is functional but not as warm/specific. ALSO: the rate-limit-incidents sidecar mislabel is itself an audit-data-integrity defect — fix the label so future reviewers don't get fooled by 'all_recovered:true' when 1 order is hard-failed.
